mapper.sql: id, business_type as businessType, business_id as businessId, business_title as businessTitle, business_status as businessStatus, assigner_id as assignerId, assigner_name as assignerName, assignee_id as assigneeId, assignee_name as assigneeName, reason, status, result, result_remark as resultRemark, handled_at as handledAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.insert: insert into approval_countersign ( business_type, business_id, business_title, business_status, assigner_id, assigner_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, reason, status ) values ( #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{businessTitle}, #{businessStatus}, #{assignerId}, #{assignerName}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{reason}, coalesce(nullif(#{status}, ''), '待加签') )
mapper.update: update approval_countersign set status = #{status}, result = #{result}, result_remark = #{resultRemark}, handled_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = '待加签'
update approval_countersign set status = '已取消', result = '已取消', result_remark = #{resultRemark}, handled_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = '待加签'
